programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie LaHaye bids a reluctant goodbye at the grave of her late husband Willie, who died two years previously in the line of duty as the sheriff of Tettsford Junction. Even after giving up her job as the town schoolteacher, Missie has found running the ranch on her own overwhelming, so she has resigned herself to letting her son Jeff and his new bride take control of it jointly with her brothers Aaron and Arnie.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: In a time when and place where women were not usually permitted careers, especially in the medical field, Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) deeply wants to be a Physician and feels that God has called her to be one. She displays her abilities while helping out a local doctor and caring for Mrs. Stafford-Smith (Nancy Linehan Charles), an elderly woman who recently had a stroke.

programme.title: Cavedweller
programme.desc: A traumatic event sends a musician back to her hometown in an effort to reunite with the daughters she abandoned.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, a city where people come to escape, shield secrets, and bury their pasts, we follow this mysterious outbreak as it threatens to disrupt what little stability high school guidance counselor Madison Clark and English teacher Travis Manawa have managed to assemble. The pressure of blending two families while dealing with resentful, escapist, and strung out children takes a back seat when society begins to break down. A forced evolution, and survival of the fittest takes hold, as our dysfunctional family finds they must either reinvent themselves or embrace their darker histories.

programme.title: Casanova
programme.desc: He was the world's most notorious seducer. A swashbuckler, master of disguise and wit - it was said no woman could resist Casanova's amorous charms. Until now. For the first time in his life, the legendary Casanova (Heath Ledger) is about to meet his match with an alluring Ventian beauty, Francesca (Sienna Miller), who does the one thing he never thought possible: refuse him. Through a series of clever disguises and scheming ruses, he manages to get ever closer to Francesca. But he is playing the most dangerous game he has ever encountered - one that will risk not only his life and reputation, but his only chance at true passion.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: The story is about Kunal (Kunal Khemu) who believes he can do anything by trying his hardest. He receives a job offer through his friend Shawn (Teeshay) and his wife Nandini (Puja Gupta (actress)) in Cape Town and moves there with his wife Aarzoo (Amrita Puri). They live a happy life together, until Kunal becomes extremely workaholic. Kunal's nature irritates Aarzoo which leads to frequent outbursts and quarrels. Kunal becomes the most trusted employee of his boss Dharmesh Zaveri (Manish Chaudhary). This thing angers Dinesh Zaveri, Dharmesh Zaveri's younger brother. Kunal advances in his job. Soon Dharmesh is revealed to be an underworld gangster. The company Kunal works in deals with exporting diamonds; Kunal has no idea that it happens illegally. His boss, Mr. Zakaria, sends his hot colleague Rosa to charm Kunal and take him away from his wife. Following the day when Kunal gets drunk in a party, Rosa takes advantage and manages to make love with him. Kunal reaches his house and finds Aarzoo sleeping and accidentally wakes her up, after which they both pick up a quarrel. Soon enough, Kunal realises the crime he is a part of and decides to and leave Cape Town. However, Zakaria knows that Kunal is aware of the illegal business and the only way to keep him silent is to kill him.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: Ronald Reagan turned from a liberal movie star to an exceptionally conservative politician and stunned the nation when he became governor of the largest state. The Reagans skilfully used American myth-making to rise to power. This documentary also takes a look at the relentless shift to the right of business, prompting Reagan to become a champion of a contained government.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: An analysis of Reagan's view of the race issue and his role as an advocate of authority and order who used racist strategies to win elections. The similarities with the current political landscape and the tactics employed by some Republicans are striking. Nancy also comes to the fore as a political force.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.title: Stealing Sinatra
programme.desc: In need of a grubstake, a young man convinces a couple of friends to help him kidnap Frank Sinatra Jr.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: Prairie Fever
programme.desc: Western adventure starring Kevin Sorbo and Dominique Swain. A drunken former lawman is given the chance to clear his debts by escorting three eccentric women back East. (2008).

programme.title: The Hollywood Mom's Mystery
programme.desc: Lucy Freers has a long-standing marriage, a nine-year old daughter, and a great family life in the suburbs of Hollywood. Great, that is, until the Hollywood set decides that motherhood is the newest way to go. When local neighbor Julia Prentice, the wife of a famous movie actor, adopts a baby in full view of the show-business media, the parenthood craze hits its peak. Soon after, Julia is found lying dead in Lucy's swimming pool, with Lucy and her husband labeled as suspects. Now Lucy must determine the truth to clear the name of both herself and her family.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments
programme.desc: One of the most famous stories from The Bible, this mini-series sees the Hebrew infant, Moses, being raised in the Egyptian royal household. When his true identity is revealed, he sets out to reclaim his heritage. Later, the plagues descend on Egypt, and Pharaoh frees the Hebrews only to change his mind and pursue them to the Red Sea where the parting of the waves ensures their escape. After receiving the Ten Commandments, Moses faces an orgy of excess amongst his tribe.

programme.title: Sherlock Homes: The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson are called to Whitechapel after learning about a series of strange murders only two years after the Jack the Ripper murders in the same neighborhood. The local belief is that the killings are the work of a vampire brought back from a recent mission in Guyana. As they investigate the deaths, they engage in an ongoing debate about the supernatural, with Watson believing in the possibility of vampires and Holmes remaining skeptical until he is able to prove the murders are the works of a living human, rather than any undead creature. At one point, the investigation leads them to the psychic Madame Karasky, who says that Holmes will be saved by the church. Shortly thereafter, Holmes is pushed in front of a moving carriage by the supposed vampire, only to be saved by a pedestrian. In order to catch the murderer, Holmes disguises himself as a monk and reveals that the vampire was Brother Abel, who hoped to get revenge on the monks who didn't listen to him when he believed that the bats were causing rabies in the South American mission, when he was infected. The film ends at Baker Street, when Mrs. Hudson gives Holmes his pipe, delivered by the same man that saved Holmes from being run over. When Holmes asks his name, Mrs. Hudson says his name was Reginald Church.

programme.title: The Hot Potato
programme.desc: London's East End 1969. Based on real events. Two chancers "find" a lump of Uranium and crisscross Europe to find a buyer. Accompanied by Danny's girl,the lovely Carole. They encounter a diverse cast of bizarre characters, all trying to steal the 'Hot Potato', but a deal agreed inside the Vatican has the co-conspirators confounding each other. The story twists and turns to an exciting and unexpected finale.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno (star of the 1970s/80s TV series The Incredible Hulk), Sybil Danning, Ingrid Anderson and Mirella D'Angelo take the lead roles in Italian writer-director Luigi Cozzi's mythological romp for the low-budget action specialists The Cannon Group. The narrative starts with the creation of the universe, at the end of which Pandora's jar is broken, releasing evil into the world. Greek god Zeus (Claudio Cassinelli) decides to protect mankind from evil by creating a hero and sends divine light down to Bronze Age Thebes, where it enters the body of a royal baby. The infant survives a bloody palace coup instigated by Adriana (Danning), daughter of a rival monarch, and the malicious interventions of Zeus's wronged wife Hera (Rossana Podestŕ) to become the immensely strong Hercules (Ferrigno). But adulthood doesn't see an end to the relentless campaign to destroy him. And when Adriana captures his love Cassiopea (Anderson), Hercules joins forces with the sorceress Circe (D'Angelo) to save Cassiopea.

programme.desc: Katie Parker (Lucy Hale) and Sara Snow (Phoebe Strole) have been friends since childhood. They enter college together, where Katie is a prized legacy candidate for the Delta sorority, which was co-founded decades ago by her mother, Lutie (Courtney Thorne-Smith) and Summer (Faith Ford), whose own daughter Gwen (Amanda Schull) now leads the Deltas on campus. Events occur during pledge week to cause a rift between Katie and the Deltas, which leaves Sara as a Delta pledge and Katie out in the cold. programme.title: Hard Ground
programme.desc: Billy Bucklin escapes while being transported to Yuma prison and plans to form an army of desperadoes to control the Mexican border. To finance his band, he robs a stagecoach, kidnaps a beautiful woman to be sold into prostitution, and steals an army payroll wagon. An aging lawman persuades the governor to parole his brother-in-law, now serving a 20-year prison term for murder, to assist him and his green deputy to destroy the marauders.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's (Erin Cottrell) surprise discovery - her pregnancy - sets her on a new course that's at once thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie (Logan Bartholomew), have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Later on they meet Jeff Huff and his older brother Sonny. They later make new friends and spend Christmas together.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: The Wild Girl
programme.desc: Ned Giles, an aspiring news photographer, joins the 1932 Great Apache Expedition on the search for a young boy, the son of a wealthy Mexican land owner who was kidnapped by wild Apaches. Ned finds himself on an unexpected and perilous journey through rugged terrain, when a captured wild Apache girl must be exchanged for the kidnapped boy.

programme.title: Gleason
programme.desc: Biopic of hugely popular American actor and comedian Jackie Gleason (Brad Garrett), who never quite defeated his numerous insecurities, finding it difficult to maintain close relationships as a result.

programme.title: Strange Relations
programme.desc: Drama with Paul Reiser. When a Jewish New York psychologist is diagnosed with leukemia, his mother reveals that he was adopted from a Catholic teenager in the UK, leading to a journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Hans Christian Andersen: My Life as a Fairy Tale
programme.desc: First of a two-part fictionalised account of the early life of Hans Christian Andersen, a young man with a penchant for storytelling but who struggles to find his place in the world and gain the affection of the woman he adores. Interspersed throughout are brief interludes of the stories that made him famous.

programme.title: Hans Christian Andersen: My Life as a Fairy Tale
programme.desc: A fictionalised account of the early life of Hans Christian Andersen, a young man with a penchant for storytelling but who struggles to find his place in the world and gain the affection of the woman he adores. Interspersed throughout are brief interludes of the stories that made him famous.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom
programme.desc: The Forbidden Kingdom (2008) is a kung fu wuxia film directed by Rob Minkoff and starring Jackie Chan and Jet Li. Teenager Jason, who lives in South Boston, is crazy about kung fu. One day he makes an amazing discovery: in one of Chinatown shops he finds the legendary staff which belongs to the great warrior Monkey King. The magic staff sends Jason on an adventure to ancient China, where he joins an army of highly skilled warriors gathered to free their imprisoned king.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: The story is about Kunal (Kunal Khemu) who believes he can do anything by trying his hardest. He receives a job offer through his friend Shawn (Teeshay) and his wife Nandini (Puja Gupta (actress)) in Cape Town and moves there with his wife Aarzoo (Amrita Puri). They live a happy life together, until Kunal becomes extremely workaholic. Kunal's nature irritates Aarzoo which leads to frequent outbursts and quarrels. Kunal becomes the most trusted employee of his boss Dharmesh Zaveri (Manish Chaudhary). This thing angers Dinesh Zaveri, Dharmesh Zaveri's younger brother. Kunal advances in his job. Soon Dharmesh is revealed to be an underworld gangster. The company Kunal works in deals with exporting diamonds; Kunal has no idea that it happens illegally. His boss, Mr. Zakaria, sends his hot colleague Rosa to charm Kunal and take him away from his wife. Following the day when Kunal gets drunk in a party, Rosa takes advantage and manages to make love with him. Kunal reaches his house and finds Aarzoo sleeping and accidentally wakes her up, after which they both pick up a quarrel. Soon enough, Kunal realises the crime he is a part of and decides to and leave Cape Town. However, Zakaria knows that Kunal is aware of the illegal business and the only way to keep him silent is to kill him.

programme.title: Prairie Fever
programme.desc: Western adventure starring Kevin Sorbo and Dominique Swain. A drunken former lawman is given the chance to clear his debts by escorting three eccentric women back East. (2008).

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: Ronald Reagan turned from a liberal movie star to an exceptionally conservative politician and stunned the nation when he became governor of the largest state. The Reagans skilfully used American myth-making to rise to power. This documentary also takes a look at the relentless shift to the right of business, prompting Reagan to become a champion of a contained government.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Pirėjo „Olympiakos“ - Stambulo „Fenerbahce“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 4
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Vimbldono turnyras. Highlights Day 7
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Madrido „Real“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Killer Safari

Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Compilations
programme.desc: Our world is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have evolved to survive amid harsh environments, and brutal competition. But in every region resides an elite group of twelve species -- an assembly of mammals, reptiles, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory and defensive skills. They're beautiful, they're highly evolved, and they're dangerous-they are the Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: World's Biggest Great White?

programme.title: Bull Shark vs. Hammerhead
programme.desc: A rare event between top ocean predators was captured on video in Florida: bull sharks attacking a great hammerhead. Dr. Heithaus and a team of shark experts launch an investigation pinning one against the other. They put experiments to the test to see what will happen when these top predators come head-to-head.

programme.title: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most dangerous mission yet, diving into wild waters home to the ocean's great white sharks.

programme.title: Shark Attack Files
programme.desc: In Gracetown, Australia, two surfers are attacked just a few hours apart on the same beach. In New South Wales, another surfer has a close call when a great white takes a bite of his board. And in Tampa, Florida, a juvenile bull shark injures a girl paddleboarding with her family. At surf spots across the globe, sharks attack surfers at alarming rates. Recent data shows surfers account for a third of unprovoked shark bites worldwide. What is it about riding the breaks that has sharks seeing red? Researchers investigate terrifying close calls and gruesome attacks from America to Australia. They examine evidence and test theories to learn why surfers remain high on the shark hit list, all in the hope of saving lives.

programme.title: Return of the White Shark
programme.desc: Cape Cod — America's Playground — is a newly emerging hotspot for a top predator. Great Whites are appearing in increasing numbers, when for centuries there were none. Through spectacular imagery, we'll see how the landscape of Cape Cod has changed over time, and what is luring Great Whites in record numbers.

programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: An expert river guide in Zimbabwe meets more than his match in treacherous waters. Despite repeated maulings that leave him with 38 major bite wounds, he survives to tell his tale. In the Pacific Northwest, a civil servant on a getaway weekend suffers a very uncivilized fate. Ambushed by a hungry animal, he goes toe to toe with his attacker to save himself and his dogs.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: The 7,000 islands of the Philippines are home to over 25,000 species that are found nowhere else on earth. With almost 180 snakes to choose from in the hunt for his top ten, Nigel plunges into jungle-covered mountains, through lush paddy fields and into pristine underground rivers. He's seeking a sea serpent with a deadly bite and the world's most venomous cobra. Along the way he meets the world's largest eagle, a gecko with grip and a band of brothers who are saving the lives of local farmers.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Mexico is home to an incredible 400 snake species, nearly a fifth of which are venomous. Nigel searches high and low for his top ten, from ancient oak and pine forests to the towering cacti of the baking hot Mexican desert. Rattlesnakes dominate the landscape, but the widely feared terciopelo and the beautiful Taylor's Cantil are also in the running for number one spot. It's not just snakes that bite here - Nigel has a painful encounter with a lizard with jaws like a vice.

programme.title: Monster Snakes
programme.desc: From anacondas to man-eating reticulated pythons, we will investigate some of the biggest and baddest serpents around the world.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: A hurricane sets two vastly different species on a collision course off the coast of North Carolina when a group of surfers paddle into waters patrolled by one of Earth's most ancient and deadly marine animals. And in Fort Collins, Colorado, a trail runner's training session devolves into hand-to-hand combat with a stealthy, heavily-armed mammal.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: In the San Gabriel Mountains above Los Angeles, one false step turns a young couple's romantic hike into a desperate battle to save life and limb. And on the trip of a lifetime to the Zambezi River, avid nature photographers fall victim to one of Africa's most lethal animals. A trip that started as a birthday celebration ends with the greatest gift - survival.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: In Wyoming, when an outdoorsman bags an elk, his kill attracts the forest's apex predator. After fighting off his half-ton attacker with a kitchen knife, the hunter becomes a medical marvel as surgeons put Humpty Dumpty together again. And one of earth's oldest marine predators changes the course of a woman's life when she sets out to solve the riddle of the intense pain it can inflict.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

Sniege įstrigusias transporto priemones gali išvaduoti tik patyrę gelbėtojai, apsiginklavę specialia technika ir prietaisais. Gelbėjimo darbams tampant vis aktualesniems - Thordas, Bjornas, Jo Rogeris investuoja į naują techniką ir tikisi verslo suklestėjimo.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Unfortunately, it takes Cosmo and Wanda's magic to give Dad a green thumb, and when they're swept away by a tornado, it's up to Timmy to save the farm…and his fairies! // When monsters start appearing in Dimmsdale, Mr. Crocker launches a web show to expose them. Turns out the monsters are being poofed up by Timmy's fairies - and this is Crocker's big chance to catch them red-handed.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

Cosmo, Wanda and Peri sneak into Jorgen's office and use his tracker to find them. Hazel and Dev end up stuck in the Un-Wish Zone, trapped by the Un-wish Dragon. Together they must battle the dragon and find their way back to their fairies before Jorgen finds out! // When band and orchestra tryouts happen at school, Hazel finds herself stuck in the middle of a rivalry between the two. Rather than choose a side, she wishes to be good at all instruments and ends up in both. Exhausted from the double life she's living, she wishes that the band and orchestra had nothing to be rivals about. In granting the wish, Cosmo and Wanda get rid of all music on Earth. Hazel, with the help of the Nmusic Phairy (silent N), must restore music to Earth and end this rivalry once and for all!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: During a visit from Antony, Hazel's wish lands them inside "Rattleconda Racers," a board game they invented. Once in the game, however, they bicker about the best way to play. Hazel wants to stick to the rules they used to play by, but Antony wants to make new ones. When the formidable Rhonda the Rattleconda takes off with Cosmo and Wanda, intending to make them her next meal, Hazel and Antony must confront the tension in their relationship to save them and escape the game! // When Hazel must give a presentation on what she wants to be when she grows up, she is excited to share her dreams of being a geologist! Wanting to wow her classmates, she wishes she could excavate an "out of this world" rock to show them. Cosmo and Wanda poof her underground to find a super special rock, and she does! But in the process, she angers a group of rock monsters and must use her knowledge of geology to win them over, get her rock back, and escape the cave!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev is bummed at his own birthday party because his dad is off working. Hazel tries to cheer him up by wishing for a pair of rocket boots for him. He is stoked! Then, a party princess arrives, but this is no ordinary party princess, it's VICKY from the original series. Meanwhile, Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri stumble into a secret room, where they discover that Dale has been investigating Hazel since Founder's Day. Back at the party, Vicky, rotten as ever, forces the kids to make crafts for her online store instead of having fun. Hazel comes up with a plan full of zany traps to stop Vicky and take the party back! When Dev discovers his dad has been researching Hazel instead of spending time with him, Dev lashes out at Hazel and wishes Peri away. Left alone with his anger, is there a devious plan hatching in Dev's mind?

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Veri American Idiots
programme.desc: Rob, Steelo e Rosci Diaz controllano CANINE CAR CATASTROPHES, ascoltano tutte le CRAPPY CONFESSIONS e guardano chi vince in UNAMAZING RACES.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Veri American Idiots
programme.desc: Rob, Steelo con Rocsi Diaz assistono a dei compagni di squadra che si fanno fuori a vicenda in TEAMMATE TAKEDOWN.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Veri American Idiots
programme.desc: In questo episodio Rob e Steelo sono accompagnati da Kristy Sarah.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Veri American Idiots
programme.desc: In questo episodio Rob e Steelo sono accompagnati da Lolo Wood.

programme.title: Above Suspicion
programme.desc: Un agente dell'FBI sposato da poco deve cercare informazioni in una cittadina del Kentucky. L'uomo inizia una relazione con una donna del posto, la quale diventa la sua principale fonte d'informazione. La giovane vede in lui un modo per fuggire.

programme.title: L'ammissione
programme.desc: Tina Fey e Paul Rudd in una divertente commedia. La vita di Portia, responsabile alle ammissioni di Princeton, viene sconvolta quando ritrova John, un ex compagno del college.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Last Breath
programme.desc: La storia vera di un gruppo di palombari esperti, che sfidano la natura per salvare un compagno di equipaggio rimasto intrappolato a centinaia di metri sotto la superficie dell'oceano.

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Tahar Rahim (Il profeta) è Charles Aznavour. Dalla difficile infanzia nella Parigi popolare all’incontro con Édith Piaf, il viaggio umano e artistico di un’icona senza tempo.

programme.title: Internship, The
programme.desc: Un'assassina addestrata è pronta a smantellare il programma top secret della CIA che le ha rubato la giovinezza. Dopo aver radunato altri agenti, guida una sanguinosa rivolta che costringe la CIA a schierare forze altrettanto letali per fermarli.

programme.title: Odio l'estate
programme.desc: Aldo, Giovanni e Giacomo nella commedia di successo di Massimo Venier. Per un errore, tre famiglie sono costrette a passare le vacanze estive nella stessa casa al mare.

programme.title: The Batman (2022)
programme.desc: Robert Pattinson e' il supereroe di Gotham City nella versione noir di Matt Reeves, con Zoe Kravitz e Colin Farrell. Batman segue gli indizi misteriosi lasciati da un sadico serial killer.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Un appassionante thriller con il Premio Oscar Morgan Freeman e John Cusack ("2012"). Frank Cordell era un sicario al servizio del governo che ha deciso di 'mettersi in proprio'. Arrestato in una piccola citta', riesce a fuggire mentre viene scortato fino a Washington da alcuni agenti dell'FBI. Frank riesce a nascondersi tra i boschi, dove si trova anche Ray Keene, un ex poliziotto in campeggio con il figlio Chris. Dopo averlo tratto in salvo, Ray vuole consegnarlo alla giustizia ma gli uomini di Cordell sono sulle loro tracce per liberarlo e portare a termine il loro incarico.

programme.title: Una notte al museo

programme.title: Un uragano all'improvviso
programme.desc: Kate Upton e Alexandra Daddario rivali in seduzione in una commedia senza esclusione di colpi. Dirette in Florida per le agognate vacanze, due amiche di lunga data conoscono sull'aereo il bellissimo Ryan (Matt Barr) e ne sono subito attratte. Quando i passeggeri saranno costretti a un soggiorno forzato a St.Louis a causa di un uragano in arrivo, le due amiche metteranno da parte ogni scrupolo e ogni principio di lealta' pur di sedurre il loro compagno di viaggio in una girandola di imprevisti e brutte figure. Terzo film da regista per William H. Macy, attore noto soprattutto per "Fargo'.

programme.title: John Wick - Capitolo 2
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves torna a vestire i panni del killer nel sequel con Riccardo Scamarcio e Claudia Gerini. Un debito con un boss camorrista costringe John Wick a impugnare nuovamente le armi.

programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga multietnica con Christian Clavier. Per il 40esimo anniversario di matrimonio di Claude e Marie le figlie organizzano una festa a sorpresa.

programme.title: Il pesce innamorato
programme.desc: Tante risate insieme a Leonardo Pieraccioni e Paolo Hendel in una spensierata commedia sentimentale. Arturo e' un falegname diventato famoso grazie a un libro di fiabe. Durante uno dei numerosi viaggi per la promozione del suo best-seller, vive una notte di passione con la bellissima Matilde (la modella Yamila Diaz). Successivamente, stufo del peso del successo, decide di ritirarsi in una casa di legno nel bosco. Ma Matilde si rifa' viva molti mesi piu' tardi, con un neonato in braccio. La reazione dubbiosa di Arturo la spinge a fuggire per sposarsi con un altro uomo...

programme.desc: Robert Pattinson in un futuro distopico, dal regista di "Parasite". Mickey è destinato a missioni suicide e ad essere clonato ogni volta che muore. Ma la sua versione numero 17 sopravvive a un incidente su un pianeta ostile e si ritrova a convivere con la sua copia numero 18.

programme.title: 12 Soldiers
programme.desc: Chris Hemsworth e Michael Shannon in un war-movie tratto da una storia vera. Dopo l'11 settembre, una squadra speciale Usa sbarca in Afghanistan per organizzare la guerra contro Al Qaeda.

programme.desc: Harrison Ford nel thriller dal romanzo di Tom Clancy. In vacanza a Londra, l'agente della CIA Jack Ryan sventa un attentato dell'IRA ma viene braccato dal fratello di un terrorista.

programme.title: Operation Fortune
programme.desc: Action Sky Original di Guy Ritchie con Jason Statham e Hugh Grant. Una spia dell'MI6 e il suo team di agenti reclutano una star di Hollywood per una missione sotto copertura.

programme.title: Robin Hood principe dei ladri
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Alan Rickman e Morgan Freeman nell'avventuroso cult anni 90. Robin Hood addestra un gruppo di ribelli per sconfiggere la tirannia dello sceriffo di Nottingham.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Fanta-action con Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall e Morgan Freeman. Ferito dai terroristi, uno studioso di intelligenza artificiale viene connesso a un computer e sviluppa poteri illimitati.

programme.title: Now You See Me 2 - I maghi del crimine
programme.desc: Torna la banda di illusionisti in un action nel segno della magia con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo, Daniel Radcliffe e i premi Oscar Michael Caine e Morgan Freeman. Ricercati dall'Fbi, I Quattro Cavalieri non resistono alla tentazione di tornare in azione, per smascherare Owen Case, un corrotto magnate della tecnologia. Elaborano un meticoloso piano che li condurra' fino a Macao, in una trappola ideata dal giovane ex socio di Case (Daniel Radcliffe). Per salvare la reputazione e la loro stessa vita, i Cavalieri dovranno mettere in scena un vero e proprio show.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: Ray, ex soldato britannico, si è da tempo autoesiliato dalla famiglia e dalla società. Quando Jem, il fratello, parte alla sua ricerca, segreti nascosti e rancori sepolti da tempo vengono alla luce.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Robin Hood principe dei ladri
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Alan Rickman e Morgan Freeman nell'avventuroso cult anni 90. Robin Hood addestra un gruppo di ribelli per sconfiggere la tirannia dello sceriffo di Nottingham.

programme.desc: Fanta-action con Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall e Morgan Freeman. Ferito dai terroristi, uno studioso di intelligenza artificiale viene connesso a un computer e sviluppa poteri illimitati.

programme.title: Jane Austen ha stravolto la mia vita
programme.desc: Agathe è affascinante quanto contraddittoria. È single, ma sogna una storia d'amore degna dei romanzi di Jane Austen. È libraia, ma sogna di diventare scrittrice. Ha un'immaginazione sfrenata, ma una sessualità inesistente.

programme.title: Buona giornata
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Diego Abatantuono, Christian De Sica e Lino Banfi. L'Italia di oggi in sette episodi su politici corrotti, escort, quiz televisivi e tifosi di calcio.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham e Idris Elba nel primo spin-off della saga. Gli agenti Hobbs e Shaw si alleano per fermare un terrorista che minaccia di decimare la razza umana con un virus.

programme.title: King Arthur: Il potere della spada
programme.desc: Guy Ritchie rilegge il mito di Re Artù, con Charlie Hunnam e Jude Law. Cresciuto nei sobborghi di Londra, Arthur estrae la spada dalla roccia e sfida Vortigern per sedere sul trono.

programme.title: Il ciclone
programme.desc: In un paesino della Toscana vive la famiglia Quarini, il padre Osvaldo e i tre figli Levante, Libero e Selvaggia. Un giorno una compagnia spagnola di flamenco arriva e porta nuovo e contagioso entusiasmo nella vita dei quattro.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: Ray, ex soldato britannico, si è da tempo autoesiliato dalla famiglia e dalla società. Quando Jem, il fratello, parte alla sua ricerca, segreti nascosti e rancori sepolti da tempo vengono alla luce.

programme.title: Gran Turismo - La storia di un sogno impossibile
programme.desc: Corse adrenaliniche ispirate a una storia vera che vede al centro il celebre videogame. Un concorso per giocatori di 'Gran Turismo' diventa l'occasione della vita per un ragazzo.

programme.title: 2 cuori e 2 capanne
programme.desc: Alessandra e Valerio non potrebbero essere più diversi. Le loro strade si incrociano per caso su un tram e passano una notte assieme. Il giorno dopo si rendono conto di lavorare nella stessa scuola.

programme.title: Memory: Trappole della mente
programme.desc: Nel tentativo di superare l'eredità di suo padre, un neuroscienziato solitario rimane impigliato nel suo esperimento, mettendo 10 frammenti della sua coscienza uno contro l'altro.

programme.title: Emily
programme.desc: Frances O'Connor esordisce alla regia con il biopic sull'autrice di 'Cime tempestose', interpretata da Emma Mackey. L’equilibrio della famiglia Bronte è scosso dall’arrivo del nuovo Pastore.

programme.title: Il Concorso
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Gugu Mbatha-Raw nel biopic su una storica battaglia femminista. Londra, 1970: il ‘Women's Liberation Movement’ irrompe in diretta televisiva durante il concorso per l’elezione di Miss Mondo in segno di protesta contro la strumentalizzazione delle donne.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket (Edizione Deluxe)
programme.desc: La 'sporca guerra' secondo Stanley Kubrick in un film epocale con Matthew Modine. Al campo di addestramento di Parris Island il severissimo sergente di ferro Hartman addestra diciassette reclute a diventare spietati marines: i suoi metodi, durissimi e mortificanti, sono in grado di trasformare i soldati in vere e proprie macchine da guerra, pronte per affrontare l'orrore del conflitto in Vietnam. Come il soldato Joker e il soldato Cowboy che si ritroveranno al fronte, nel cuore del paese di Ho Chi Minh, nel mirino di un misterioso cecchino viet cong.

programme.title: War - La guerra desiderata
programme.desc: War-dramedy di Gianni Zanasi con Edoardo Leo, Miriam Leone, Giuseppe Battiston. La guerra tra Italia e Spagna unisce le vite di un allevatore di vongole e della figlia di un politico.

programme.title: Il grande Lebowski
programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: What They Had
programme.desc: Hilary Swank e Michael Shannon in un dramma familiare. Tornata nella casa di Chicago per gestire la malattia della madre, Bridget è costretta a fare i conti con rancori mai sopiti.

programme.title: Quei bravi ragazzi
programme.desc: Robert De Niro e Ray Liotta in un capolavoro di Martin Scorsese, miglior regia a Venezia. Lo spietato mondo della mafia newyorkese raccontato da un gangster pentito. Oscar a Joe Pesci.

programme.title: L'ombra delle spie
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch in un thriller targato Sky Original tratto da una storia vera. 1960: un uomo d'affari inglese, spia per conto della CIA, viene coinvolto in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: Il Padrino: Epilogo - La morte di Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Joseph Gordon-Levitt interpreta Edward Snowden in un biografia che Oliver Stone gira con la potenza di un incalzante thriller politico. Nel 2013, il giovane informatico si licenzia dalla National Security Agency, abbandona i suoi rigidi ideali patriottici e convoca due giornalisti in un albergo di Hong Kong, ai quali rivelera' la subdola e diffusa violazione della privacy elaborata dal governo americano. Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

programme.title: Aprile
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: Penguin Bloom
programme.desc: Naomi Watts e Andrew Lincoln in un'emozionante storia vera. Paralizzata a causa di un incidente, una donna trova il coraggio di ricominciare prendendosi cura di una gazza ferita.

programme.title: Il caso Spotlight
programme.desc: Due Oscar al dramma d'inchiesta con Mark Ruffalo, Rachel McAdams e Michael Keaton. Un team di giornalisti di Boston indaga sugli abusi sessuali perpetrati da oltre 70 sacerdoti.

programme.title: What They Had
programme.desc: Hilary Swank e Michael Shannon in un dramma familiare. Tornata nella casa di Chicago per gestire la malattia della madre, Bridget è costretta a fare i conti con rancori mai sopiti.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Joseph Gordon-Levitt interpreta Edward Snowden in un biografia che Oliver Stone gira con la potenza di un incalzante thriller politico. Nel 2013, il giovane informatico si licenzia dalla National Security Agency, abbandona i suoi rigidi ideali patriottici e convoca due giornalisti in un albergo di Hong Kong, ai quali rivelera' la subdola e diffusa violazione della privacy elaborata dal governo americano. Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

programme.title: I guerrieri della notte
programme.desc: Capolavoro di Walter Hill e un classico dell'action. New York: accusati di omicidio, i Warriors devono sfuggire alla ritorsione delle bande rivali nel corso di una lunga notte di agguati.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Limonov
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Emmanuel Carrère, Kirill Serebrennikov dirige un film sulla travolgente vita dello scrittore e politico Eduard Limonov (Ben Whishaw) tra Russia, America ed Europa.

programme.title: Intervista a Matilda De Angelis
programme.desc: Matilda De Angelis, protagonista del film "La lezione" con Stefano Accorsi, ci racconta aneddoti e curiosità sul set del thriller diretto da Stefano Mordini.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Nato il quattro luglio
programme.desc: Due Oscar al biopic di Oliver Stone con Tom Cruise. La vera storia di Ron Kovic: rimasto paralizzato nell'inferno del Vietnam, torna in patria e diventa un leader pacifista.

programme.title: Il Maestro
programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Joseph Gordon-Levitt interpreta Edward Snowden in un biografia che Oliver Stone gira con la potenza di un incalzante thriller politico. Nel 2013, il giovane informatico si licenzia dalla National Security Agency, abbandona i suoi rigidi ideali patriottici e convoca due giornalisti in un albergo di Hong Kong, ai quali rivelera' la subdola e diffusa violazione della privacy elaborata dal governo americano. Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: La battaglia di Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al War movie di Mel Gibson con Andrew Garfield, da una storia vera. Seconda guerra mondiale: un soldato ottiene la medaglia al valore malgrado il rifiuto di impugnare le armi.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Due uomini ossessionati dalle teorie complottistiche rapiscono l'amministratrice delegata di una grande azienda, convinti che sia un'aliena che vuole distruggere la Terra.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Nato il quattro luglio
programme.desc: Due Oscar al biopic di Oliver Stone con Tom Cruise. La vera storia di Ron Kovic: rimasto paralizzato nell'inferno del Vietnam, torna in patria e diventa un leader pacifista.

programme.title: Italia 1982 - Una storia azzurra
programme.desc: Il documentario che ripercorre il trionfo della nazionale italiana di calcio al Mundial spagnolo: una vittoria indelebile che ha ispirato una generazione e riunito un'intera nazione.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Saint Judy
programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Due uomini ossessionati dalle teorie complottistiche rapiscono l'amministratrice delegata di una grande azienda, convinti che sia un'aliena che vuole distruggere la Terra.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Piccole donne
programme.desc: Rilettura di un classico diretto da Greta Gerwig con Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Laura Dern e Meryl Streep. La storia delle sorelle March nell'America della Guerra Civile. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: Bolero
programme.desc: La genesi ossessiva della celebre partitura di Maurice Ravel nel biopic di Anne Fontaine. La vita, la carriera e il tormento creativo dell'artista, fino al suo capolavoro musicale.

programme.title: I Goonies
programme.desc: Richard Donner firma una memorabile avventura ideata e prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Un gruppo di ragazzi trova una mappa che conduce al leggendario tesoro di un pirata.

programme.title: Arma letale
programme.desc: Mel Gibson e Danny Glover nel primo capitolo della saga action di Richard Donner. Un poliziotto saggio e un collega impulsivo collaborano per sgominare una banda di narcotrafficanti.

programme.title: Gioia mia
programme.desc: Gioia, un'insegnante di letteratura francese, instaura un legame proibito, fragile e inspiegabilmente necessario con Alessio, un suo studente. Quest'ultimo però distrugge tutto e cancella l'unica persona che lo abbia mai amato.

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.title: Io sono ancora qui
programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.title: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano a colpi di film iconici del leggendario duo, disponibili su Sky Cinema e Sky On Demand.

programme.title: Nati CON La Camicia
programme.desc: Rosco Fraker è uno stravagante ventriloquo che gira il mondo in pattini a rotelle, Doug O'Riordan un ex detenuto dal pugno facile e il cuore tenero, appena uscito di galera. I due si incontrano in un bar, nel bel mezzo di una rissa.

programme.title: Chi Trova Un Amico Trova Un Tesoro
programme.desc: Alan e Charlie si recano su un'isola del Pacifico per cercare di un misterioso tesoro risalente alla seconda guerra mondiale. Giunti sul posto, i due scoprono ben presto di dover competere con altri uomini cacciatori di tesori.

programme.title: Non c'e' due senza quattro
programme.desc: Due uomini, uno stuntman e un sassofonista, prendono il posto di due miliardari minacciati di morte da dei sicari.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe svolge il suo commercio di banane che scambia con altri prodotti per i suoi protetti, gli indigeni del villaggio. Un giorno arriva un boss della malavita che vorrebbe impiantare una industria, colonizzazione di Amantido...

programme.title: I Due Superpiedi Quasi Piatti
programme.desc: Ladruncoli dal cuore buono, il furbo Matt e il massiccio Wilbur, un giorno si trovano casualmente arruolati nella polizia. Con Terence Hill e Bud Spencer. Regia di E. Barboni; ITA 1977.

programme.title: Pari e dispari
programme.desc: Il guardiamarina Johnny Firpo viene incaricato dai suoi superiori di indagare su una banda di allibratori clandestini operanti in Florida. Dato che egli ignora quasi tutto del gioco, verrà affiancato da qualcuno che, invece, ne sappia.

programme.title: Miami supercops: I poliziotti dell'8a strada
programme.desc: Doug e Steve sono grandi amici: il primo lavora per l'FBI, il secondo ha lasciato l'agenzia perché nauseato dalla burocrazia che, secondo lui, lega le mani alla giustizia. La riapertura di un caso, però, richiede l'esperienza e l'astuzia di entrambi.

programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga, Venom e il suo ospite umano, Eddie Brock, sono di ritorno a New York ma devono guardarsi dalle forze dell'ordine e dagli Xenofagi, indistruttibili mostri alieni provenienti dal pianeta di Venom.

programme.desc: Tom Hardy incarna uno dei personaggi più enigmatici della Marvel. Un parassita entra nel corpo di un giornalista dando vita a un'entità metà umana e metà aliena. Nel cast Michelle Williams.

programme.title: Il Grinch
programme.desc: Animazione campione d'incassi targata Illumination tratta dal racconto del Dr. Seuss. Lo scontroso mostriciattolo verde odia lo spirito del Natale ed elabora un piano per sabotare la festa.

programme.title: Minions 2 - Come Gru diventa cattivissimo
programme.desc: Grande successo per il quinto capitolo del franchise Illumination con le amate creature gialle. Los Angeles, anni '70: l'adolescente Gru cresce in perfidia e sogna di entrare nei Malefici 6.

programme.title: Hop
programme.desc: Quando Fred, investe accidentalmente il coniglio pasquale, non ha la minima idea di quello che dovrà sopportare nei giorni successivi. Per salvare la Pasqua, infatti, dovrà prendersi cura del coniglio e sostituirlo.

programme.title: Cattivissimo me 3
programme.desc: Terzo successo al box office per i personaggi targati Illumination. Mentre i Minions si dimettono, Gru scopre di avere un fratello gemello, Dru. Insieme daranno la caccia a Balthazar Bratt.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cattivissimo me", lo spin-off che ripercorre la storia dei buffi personaggi, sempre alla ricerca di un cattivo da servire: dalla Preistoria fino alla Londra degli anni 60.

programme.title: Pets - Vita da animali
programme.desc: Animali domestici all'arrembaggio nel successo d'animazione targato Illumination. Il tenero cagnolino Max si allea con il randagio Duke per fermare il piano del coniglio Nevosetto.

programme.title: Cattivissimo Me 2
programme.desc: L'irresistibile sequel della trilogia che ha conquistato i botteghini. Gru e i Minions tornano in azione affiancati dall'agente Lucy Wilde per sconfiggere il temibile El Macho.

programme.title: Hop
programme.desc: Quando Fred, investe accidentalmente il coniglio pasquale, non ha la minima idea di quello che dovrà sopportare nei giorni successivi. Per salvare la Pasqua, infatti, dovrà prendersi cura del coniglio e sostituirlo.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Sing 2 - Sempre più forte
programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.title: Bla Bla Baby
